# freshdesk_sla_policies (Data Source)

Every SLA policy on the helpdesk, in evaluation order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_sla_policies" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `sla_policies`.
- `sla_policies` (Attributes List) Every SLA policy the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sla_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--sla_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sla_policies`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the policy is in force.
- `applicable_to` (String) What the policy is scoped to, as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the policy was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the policy.
- `escalation` (String) Escalation recipients, as JSON.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the SLA policy.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the fallback policy.
- `name` (String) Name of the policy.
- `position` (Number) Evaluation order of the policy.
- `sla_target` (String) Targets per priority, as JSON.
- `updated_at` (String) When the policy was last changed (RFC 3339).
